experiments.result: 15 small hardware correctness subtests passed; large wall-clock A/B had no meaningful win; profiling replay hit a timeline timeout.

Existing native unroll hook applied before two missed early returns, with total expansion capped at 16 values. Paired NumPy-checked row reduction 81.34 -> 64.11 us (HIP 62.35); layernorm 76.23 -> 64.15 us (HIP 60.25). Row cold time 182 ms versus baseline 142 ms / HIP 165 ms. Full hardware suite: 1047 passed, 66 skipped, 817 subtests. Paired GPU timestamps: row reduction 62.08 -> 24.98 us (HIP 28.60), layernorm 36.84 -> 30.74 us (HIP 28.30). Full-model regression passed: tokens exact to HIP/AMDLLVM, warm throughput retained at both chunk sizes.

CPU fence demonstrably waits without Python-wide prewait; 39 HCQ tests pass. Hardware stalls in flash warmup (100 seconds without reaching the first batch); stopped the isolated test. The candidate retains the Python prewait.

Park complete static eight-float fragments only after proving zero initialization, single-fragment ownership, and identity writeback; reject early external reads. Nonzero initial state has a hardware regression test. Large Q6 removes 64 SLOAD and 64 SSTORE with no allocator spills; final private bytes are zero. 82 ordinary compiler fixtures remain byte-identical. Two alternating Q6 A/B rounds pass independent full-output checks: 1024-token 4096x4096 kernel 3185/3198 -> 2165/2155 us, versus same-product HIP 923/905 us. Short 32-token case is unchanged at about 232 us. Those timings precede the final metadata-only private-byte removal. Complete numeric Llama generation remains exact to the prior HIP reference but throughput is unchanged (chunk32 about 1399 prefill / 299 decode tok/s; chunk1024 about 992 / 116). Do not infer an end-to-end speedup from the standalone-kernel win.

A prelude WMMA's zero pack was incorrectly sunk into a later unrelated reduction loop, causing uninitialized scratch reads. Restrict sinking to zero-MOV packs whose users all lie inside that loop. Fixed binaries pass 400 nonzero-scratch replays; 82 prior compiler fixtures remain byte-identical.

Materialize one scalar-select arm when both require different literals; reject conflicting literal words in the common AMD encoder. Fixes exact-output failures in IQ1_M, IQ1_S, IQ2_S, IQ2_XS and IQ2_XXS. Complete table and minimal physical-select tests pass; 82 prior compiler fixtures remain byte-identical.

Pending combined broad hardware/model gates. Byte-wide GLOBAL alignment reduces the independently checked key projection from 3378/3341 to 1623/1626 us, no spills, VGPR 144 -> 152. Byte offsets 0 through 15 and all runnable GGUF tables/dequantization pass. Contiguous subwave reduction lowers the original D=64 model QK score from 15817/15831 to 9253/9264 us with VGPR 24/private 0 unchanged. Seven symbolic/tail/cache shapes pass full independent references and padding sentinels; 15 small grouping variants pass. Neither isolated timing is an end-to-end performance claim.
